title: Ridgeline Plan Hardship Deferral Limits
content:
Under Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing, a hardship deferral moves scheduled monthly payments to the end of the term. The limits below set, plan by plan, how many months one deferral and the life of the account may cover, how seasoned and how current the account must be, and what a deferral does to interest and to a promotional end date.

## Limits by plan

| | Same-As-Cash 12 | Same-As-Cash 18 | Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 | Fixed-Rate 60 | Fixed-Rate 120 | Low-Payment 144 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most months one hardship deferral may cover | 0 | 0 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Most months of hardship deferral over the life of the account | 0 | 0 | 2 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Full calendar months since the funded date before a deferral can be granted | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Most days past due when a deferral is granted | 59 | 59 | 59 | 59 | 59 | 59 |
| Interest keeps accruing on deferred payments | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A deferral extends a promotional end date | No | No | No | No | No | No |

## Reading the limits

- A figure of 0 months per deferral means the plan does not offer hardship deferral: Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 12 and Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 18 offer none.
- Ridgeline Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 offers up to 2 months per deferral and 2 months over the life of the account; Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 60, Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 120 and Ridgeline Low-Payment 144 offer up to 3 months per deferral and 6 months over the life of the account.
- On every plan interest continues during a deferral and the promotional end date stays where it is.
- The most months per deferral and over the life of the account describe the base hardship rules. For a hardship request on an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the months the borrower may ask for are bounded by the hardship offer of the current hardship request basis, and the months granted by the months asked.
